Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
This document used 
for the following motors of unit 1,2:
Gas Recirculation fan motor, forced 
draft fan motor, main cooling water pump motor, and main condensate pump motor 
6kv.
The first draft is initiated by 
eng. 
Ibrahem Youssef Abdel Latif,

accepted by eng.

general director,

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Isolation and proper earthing is required.
Before starting any work on the 
 motor, check that it is 
 switched off and blocked up for switching on again.
The unit should be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth.... etc.
Lifting device, press on and detaching device.
AVO 
 meter & insulation testing.
Vibration 
 and noise level measuring devices.
Greasing device.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the vibration and noise level.
Clean the heat exchanger.
Check visually the bearing.
Grease the bearing.
Measure the insulation resistance for stator winding.
Cleaning inside terminal box and tighten bolts & earthing bolts.
General cleaning 
 for the motor.
